metadata.description: IRIS/Cache linked service via the generic ODBC connector (see ../README.md for why ODBC, not JDBC, and what integration runtime this requires). Deploy self-hosted-integration-runtime.json and linked-service-keyvault.json first -- this template does not redeclare them, only references them by name via dependsOn/resourceId. The password is always an AzureKeyVaultSecret reference; there is no parameter that accepts it in plaintext (see ../tests/test_secrets.py, which encodes that policy as a test).
IRIS superserver hostname or IP, reachable from the self-hosted IR machine.
IRIS superserver port. Not the 52773 web/management port.
IRIS namespace to expose as the ODBC 'Database'.

Exact name the InterSystems ODBC driver is registered under in odbcinst.ini on the self-hosted IR host. This varies by IRIS version/platform -- verify with 'odbcinst -q -d' on that host before deploying (see ../README.md 'Verifying the driver name').

Name of the Key Vault secret holding the IRIS password for irisUsername. This static ARM template always uses the latest secret version; the Python generator (../generator/) supports pinning a specific secretVersion if you need that.
